basis: Stock game assets; no third-party regeneration payload is included.
rate: Additional BloodPercentRegenPerSecond = 0.015 * live BloodSegmentCount. Native MMC_BloodRegen multiplies by live BloodPerSegment, the actual effect period, and the game regeneration multiplier.
name: Health Regeneration
humanRate: Additional HealthRegen = 0.015 * live MaxHealth. Native MMC_PlayerHealthRegen applies the actual effect period and HealthRegenMultiplier, clamped to MaxHealth minus PermanentDamage minus current Health.
humanEligibility: Out of combat, human form, alive, and not invulnerable. Replaces the stock Character.BlockHealthRegen exclusion with Player.IsEffectivelyInCombat to retain HumanHealthRegen eligibility.
